# RandomString

Makes a string of random characters.

## Signature

```jyro
# fragment
RandomString(length, [characterSet])
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `length` | number | The number of characters to make: a whole number from 0 to 1000000. A negative, fractional or larger number is a runtime error. |
| `characterSet` | string, optional | The characters to draw from, each UTF-16 code unit equally likely at each position; a character written twice is twice as likely. The empty string is a runtime error. A number or a boolean is read as its string form. When it is left out, or null, the 26 capital letters, the 26 small letters and the 10 digits are used. |

## Returns

String. A string of length characters, each drawn at random from characterSet. Never null.

## Remarks

Returns a random value: each call can give a different string, its characters drawn from a cryptographically secure random source.

## Example

`RandomString(8, "0123456789")` returns eight random digits, such as `"40912785"`.

Effect: non-deterministic. See [Function Effects](/docs/language/functions/function-effects).
